title: Trevor Grassi's corridor of rooms leading to the tunnel network
place_text: Giza Plateau, near the shafts between Khafre and the Sphinx, Egypt

tellings.quote: 100 m far away from these shafts and he found and he found a so-called corridor of rooms.

plain: A man named Trevor Grassi is said to have found a "corridor of rooms" underground on the Giza Plateau in Egypt, about 100 meters from the shafts between the pyramid of Khafre and the Sphinx, and that it leads to a network of tunnels. Filippo Biondi, a scientist who has scanned beneath the pyramids, passes this on as what Grassi found. If true, there would be much more built under Giza than anyone can see.
